Triggers: UE which was previously registered in S1 mode before entering state EMMDEREGISTERED performs an initial registration procedure
Actions: UE NAS provides the lower layers with a GUAMI part of the 5GGUTI mapped from 4GGUTI
UE initiates a registration procedure for mobility and periodic registration update
Flow_of_execution: Network may initiate authentication and security procedures
UE sends REGISTRATION COMPLETE message (if required)
Causes: UE entering 5G coverage after being in EMMDEREGISTERED state
UE needs to register with the network for 5G services
Expected_Outcomes: UE successfully registers with the 5G network
Error_Handling: UE is not allowed to register in the current PLMN/SNPN
Feedback_Loops: UE receives REGISTRATION REJECT message and takes appropriate action

metadata.Message_Types: REGISTRATION REQUEST, REGISTRATION ACCEPT, REGISTRATION COMPLETE
metadata.Excerpts: If the UE is not in NBN1 mode the UE has set the RACS bit to RACS supported in the 5GMM Capability IE of the REGISTRATION REQUEST message and the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message includes a a UE radio capability ID deletion indication IE set to Networkassigned UE radio capability IDs deletion requested the UE shall delete any networkassigned UE radio capability IDs associated with the RPLMN or RSNPN
